# Easy Library Books

Easy Library Books tracks the library books in WoW Forever. It shows which books you still need, where they are, and how close you are to the *Friend of the Library* rewards.

## Screenshots

The book list, with the road to the *Friend of the Library* rewards:

![The book list with the road to the rewards](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luttman/EasyLibraryBooks/main/assets/screenshot-list.png)

Missing books pinned on the Eastern Kingdoms map:

![Book pins on the Eastern Kingdoms map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luttman/EasyLibraryBooks/main/assets/screenshot-map.jpg)

## Features

- **Zone toast.** When you enter a zone with a missing book, a toast shows how many books are missing and where they are. It shows once per zone per session. Click it to open the list on the first missing book. Right-click it to dismiss it.
- **World map pins.** Missing books appear on the zone maps and on the Kalimdor and Eastern Kingdoms maps. Click a pin to set a waypoint. Shift-click a pin to open the list on that book.
- **Road to the rewards.** A card at the top shows your next reward, how many books you still need, and where to hand them in. A track marks each reward goal and shows its items. Hover an item for its tooltip.
- **Book list.** Every book by zone, with its status: missing, in bags, or delivered. Filter by status. Shift-click a book or a reward item to link it in chat.
- **Book details.** The place, the container, notes, and where to hand the book in. Set a waypoint, open the world map, or mark a book as delivered by hand.
- **Minimap button.** Left-click opens the list, right-click opens the settings, and you can drag it around the minimap. Its tooltip shows your progress and the missing books in your zone.
- **Waypoints.** Uses TomTom when it is loaded, and the Blizzard map waypoint otherwise.
- **Automatic detection.** A book is delivered when its turn-in quest is complete. It is in your bags while you carry it.

## Install

1. Download the latest release.
2. Extract the `EasyLibraryBooks` folder into the `Interface\AddOns` folder of your WoW installation.
3. Restart the game or type `/reload`.

## Usage

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/elb` | Open or close the book list. |
| `/elb toast` | Show the toast for your current zone. |
| `/elb settings` | Open the settings. |
| `/elbsettings` | Open the settings. |

`/easylibrarybooks` works like `/elb`.

## Settings

| Option | Default |
|---|---|
| Show the minimap button | On |
| Show a toast when I enter a zone with missing books | On |
| Show missing books on the world map | On |
| Also show the pins on the continent maps | On |
| Also pin books that are in my bags | Off |
| Skin: Flat, EllesmereUI, or Blizzard (needs a reload, and the addon asks for it) | EllesmereUI if installed, otherwise Flat |

## Develop

This addon is made from the `addon-template` folder of the Easy Crafting project, so it shares the Easy Crafting look. `Skin.lua` is the shared look: don't edit it here.

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `Data/Books.lua` | The books, zones, goals, and hand-in NPCs. Copied from Librarian. |
| `Books.lua` | Events, status rules, and zone helpers. |
| `Toast.lua` | The zone toast. |
| `MapPins.xml`, `MapPins.lua` | The world map pins. |
| `Waypoint.lua` | TomTom and Blizzard waypoints. |
| `Minimap.lua` | The minimap button. |
| `Media/MinimapButton.tga` | The button's texture. WoW can't load PNG or SVG. |
| `tools/make-icon.py` | Draws `assets/icon.svg`, `assets/icon.png`, and the TGA from one scene. Needs Pillow. |
| `Road.lua` | The road-to-the-rewards card at the top of the window. |
| `Main.lua` | The book list window and the slash commands. |
| `Settings.lua` | The settings and the saved variables. |

Run `lua tools/smoke.lua .` to load the addon against a fake WoW API and exercise the rules, the toast, the pins, and the window.

To update the book data, copy `Data/Books.lua` from the [Librarian](https://github.com/thoriphes/Librarian) repository.

## Credits and license

The book data, the status rules, and the map pin and toast design come from [Librarian](https://github.com/thoriphes/Librarian) by Nacho Roca (thoriphes), which is licensed under the MIT license. See `Data/LICENSE-Librarian.txt`. Book locations come from [foreverchanges.pro](https://foreverchanges.pro/library-books), Wowhead, and zockify.com, as described in Librarian's README.
